description: Films and shows that rewired how I see things. Not ratings — impressions.

picks.title: Arrival
picks.creator: Denis Villeneuve
picks.why: Changed how I think about time, language, and grief — all simultaneously. The first film that made me sit in silence after the credits.

picks.title: Interstellar
picks.creator: Christopher Nolan
picks.why: Hans Zimmer's score alone justifies the ticket. Nolan made a love letter to physics and called it a blockbuster.

picks.title: Silo
picks.creator: Graham Yost (Apple TV+)
picks.why: Possibly the most patient, slow-burn sci-fi since Arrival. Rebecca Ferguson carries every scene.

picks.title: 3 Idiots
picks.creator: Rajkumar Hirani
picks.why: I still quote Aal Izz Well to myself at 4 AM. The thesis on passion vs. marks was written for people like me.

picks.title: Severance
picks.creator: Dan Erickson (Apple TV+)
picks.why: The cleanest, most terrifying concept for modern work culture. The finale had my jaw on the floor.

picks.title: Whiplash
picks.creator: Damien Chazelle
picks.why: An electric 90-minute examination of obsession vs greatness. The drum solos feel like action sequences.

description: Channels I'd recommend before the algorithm does. Each one earns your attention.

picks.title: Veritasium
picks.creator: Derek Muller
picks.why: Makes physics feel like poetry and storytelling. The video on arrow of time kept me up for two nights.

picks.title: 3Blue1Brown
picks.creator: Grant Sanderson
picks.why: Best mathematical intuition-building I've ever seen. His linear algebra series is sacred.

picks.title: Rick Beato
picks.creator: Rick Beato
picks.why: The music theory deep dives feel like sitting with your coolest professor. 'What Makes This Song Great' changed how I hear music.

picks.title: Kurzgesagt
picks.creator: Kurzgesagt
picks.why: Makes existential dread feel beautiful and productive. Their animations are a lesson in design.

picks.title: NPTEL Physics
picks.creator: IIT Professors
picks.why: Raw, unedited chalkboard physics lectures. Pure fundamentals without flashy edits.

description: Places that earn their return visits. Spots I'd take a friend with no agenda.

picks.title: Juhu Beach at Sunset
picks.creator: Mumbai, Maharashtra
picks.why: Best people-watching in the city. The quiet couples sitting in silence here inspired 'Tere Ishq Mein'.

picks.title: Any Irani Café at 7 AM
picks.creator: Pune / Mumbai
picks.why: Bun maska, cutting chai, and a window seat is the correct morning in my book. Non-negotiable.

picks.title: Crawford Market
picks.creator: Mumbai, Maharashtra
picks.why: The most sensory overload per square meter in any city. Brilliant chaos.

picks.title: FC Road Book Stalls
picks.creator: Pune, Maharashtra
picks.why: Second-hand book browsing under afternoon tree shadows. Found my copy of Cosmos here.

picks.title: Marine Drive at 2 AM
picks.creator: Mumbai, Maharashtra
picks.why: The sound of Arabian sea waves hitting the tetrapods while the city hums behind you.

description: Albums, artists, and tracks that I loop without noticing. These are my reference points.

picks.title: Arijit Singh
picks.creator: Arijit Singh
picks.why: Technically flawless and emotionally devastating. 'Tum Hi Ho' is an entire education in phrasing.

picks.title: Hans Zimmer
picks.creator: Hans Zimmer
picks.why: Interstellar OST on repeat while writing anything important. 'First Step' specifically is perfect.

picks.title: Kishore Kumar Classics
picks.creator: Kishore Kumar
picks.why: Pure acoustic warmth. His yodeling in 'Aa Chal Ke Tujhe' is physics and soul in equal parts.

picks.title: A.R. Rahman
picks.creator: A.R. Rahman
picks.why: He doesn't compose songs, he builds entire worlds. 'Dil Se' changed Indian music permanently.

picks.title: Prateek Kuhad
picks.creator: Prateek Kuhad
picks.why: Minimal acoustic guitar and vulnerable Hindi lyrics. 'Cold/Mess' feels like an unread diary page.

description: Books and essays that left a mark. The kind that find you underlined and embarrassed.

picks.title: Cosmos
picks.creator: Carl Sagan
picks.why: The chapter on the pale blue dot made me cry and feel invincible simultaneously. Required reading for humans.

picks.title: Project Hail Mary
picks.creator: Andy Weir
picks.why: Best sci-fi novel of the decade. The alien friendship made me genuinely sob. I've recommended this to everyone.

picks.title: The Feynman Lectures on Physics
picks.creator: Richard Feynman
picks.why: Reading Feynman explain anything is like watching a magician reveal the trick and make it more magical.

picks.title: Atomic Habits
picks.creator: James Clear
picks.why: The 1% rule and identity-based habits changed how I structure my daily coding & writing routines.

description: Corners of the internet worth bookmarking. Links, tools, essays, rabbit holes.

picks.title: Explorable Explanations
picks.creator: Nicky Case
picks.why: Interactive essays that teach complex systems through play. The Evolution of Trust is the best thing I've seen online.

picks.title: Brilliant.org
picks.creator: Brilliant
picks.why: The best way to learn math and science interactively. I used their linear algebra course and it clicked things I'd struggled with for months.

picks.title: Are.na
picks.creator: Are.na
picks.why: The internet without the algorithm. The most honest way to curate and share inspiration I've found.

picks.title: Shadertoy
picks.creator: Inigo Quilez
picks.why: Pure GLSL shaders rendering photorealistic 3D scenes out of pure math formulas. Black magic.
